headlines.text: On this day in 2025, Kazuchika Okada vs. Mike Bailey went to battle over the AEW Continental Title, appearing on Double or Nothing, rated 8.49 ? a genuinely great match. Okada countered a top-rope Bailey dive with a mid-air dropkick into a Rainmaker to retain the AEW Continental Championship in a Double or Nothing classic.

2019 brought us this moment: Cody vs. Dustin Rhodes met for the very first time on Double or Nothing, rated 9.40 ? an all-timer. A passing of the torch between real-life brothers, honoring their late father Dusty Rhodes throughout ? a bloody, brutal war that left both men covered in each other's blood, later named Match of the Year and still regarded as one of the greatest brother-versus-brother matches in wrestling history.

Turning the clock back to 2022: Samoa Joe vs. Kyle O'Reilly met in an Owen Hart Tournament Match, headlining the show on Dynamite, rated 7.29 ? a good, competitive contest ? part of that year's 3 Year Anniversary.

secondaries.text: Flash back to 2024, when Castagnoli, Garcia & Tanahashi touched down in AEW for the first time as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 5.90.

Turning the clock back to 2025: Adam Page vs. Will Ospreay met in an Owen Hart Tournament Final, headlining the show on Double or Nothing, rated 9.63 ? an all-timer, on an outstanding Double or Nothing '25 show that earned an overall rating of 9.50. In a gunfight finish, Page's Buckshot Lariat beat Ospreay's Hidden Blade to win the 2025 Men's Owen Hart Cup and earn a shot at Jon Moxley's AEW World Title.

2025 brought us this moment: The Opps (Hobbs, Joe & Shibata) vs. Castagnoli, Moxley & Yuta fought it out in an Anarchy in the Arena match on Double or Nothing, rated 9.30 ? as good as professional wrestling gets ? part of a stacked Double or Nothing '25 card, rated 9.50 overall. The Opps dethroned the Death Riders for the AEW World Trios Titles inside a wild Anarchy in the Arena brawl that also crowned Swerve Strickland's team victorious elsewhere in the match.
